treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the Republic of Armenia for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2006, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: ... sopimus, jonka hyväksymistä koskevat nootit on vaihdettu 30 päivänä marraskuuta 2007, tulee voimaan 30 päivästä joulukuuta 2007 niin kuin siitä on sovittu.
source_title: Finlex up-to-date income tax treaties: Synthesised text of the MLI and the FI–AM Agreement (SopS 119-120/2007)

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which controls directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties, in the case of payments of the kind referred to in subparagraphs a) and b) of paragraph 3;
b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties, in the case of payments of the kind referred to in subparagraph c) of paragraph 3.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of [the Convention], a benefit under [the Convention] shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of [the Convention]. | ... paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI has effect ... with respect to taxes withheld at source on amounts paid or credited to nonresidents, where the event giving rise to such taxes occurs on or after 2024-01-01 (MLI Art. 7(1) replaces Art. 10(6), 11(8) and 12(7) of the Agreement)

notes: Royalty tiers are by payment type, not holding: 5% for computer software, patents, trade marks, designs/models, plans, secret formulas/processes and know-how (Art. 12(3)(a)-(b)); 10% for copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work incl. films/tapes (Art. 12(3)(c)). Interest exempt at source when paid to the State, local authorities, statutory bodies, central banks, FINNFUND/Finnish Export Credit/Finnvera or Armenian equivalents, or on loans guaranteed by them (Art. 11(3)). Treaty WHT effect: income derived on or after 1 January following EIF (Art. 28(2)(a)) = 2008-01-01. MLI: arts 6, 7, 9 apply; no Art. 8 holding period.
